question: Who composed 'Shahnama'?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Ferdowsi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Shahnama'**, also known as **'Book of Kings',** is a long epic poem written by **Ferdowsi** in the **Persian language.**
 
• The poem narrates the history of **Persia and its kings** from the creation of the world up until the Islamic conquest of Persia in the **7th century.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Alberuni **was a** scholar and historian** from Central Asia who wrote extensively on various subjects including history, geography, and astronomy.

 
 
• In a work titled **Tarikh al-Hind**, Alberuni detailed the political, social, and economic circumstances that existed in** India** in the eleventh century.
 
 
 
• **Utbi **was a **historian and chronicler** who wrote about the early Islamic conquests.
 
 
• The history of **Sebuktigin and Mahmud's** reigns is told in the **Arabic Tarikh i Yamini,** also known as Kitab i Yamini, which is written in an ornate, flowery rhetorical rhymed style.
